==Biography==
===2014 Season===
Liu "'''Crisp'''" Qing-Song, then known as '''Kuroko''', started as a substitute for [[Oh My God]] and a member of its sister team, [[Oh My God 2]]. He did not play any competitive matches during this season and left the organization later in the year.

===2016 Season===
After not playing professionally during 2015, Kuroko renamed to '''Lqs''' and joined [[Tan Chi Sa Gaming]], an amateur team. The team came in first in [[Tencent Games Arena Hero of Cities/Season 10|TGA Hero of Cities Season 10]] and qualified for the [[LSPL/2016 Season/Summer Season|2016 LSPL Summer Season]]. The team did not perform well and disbanded at the end of the split. Lqs joined [[Newbee]] at the end of the year and renamed to '''Pinus'''.

===2017 Season===
In the [[LPL/2017_Season/Spring_Season|2017 LPL Spring Season]], Newbee finished 4th in their group with 6 wins and 10 losses. In their [[LPL/2017_Season/Spring_Playoffs|playoffs]] run, they defeated [[Invictus Gaming]] 3-1 but lost 0-3 to [[EDward Gaming]] in the quarterfinals. In the [[Demacia_Cup/2017_Season|2017 Demacia Cup]] they finished 13th-20th after a 1-2 loss to [[Young Glory]]. At the end of the split, Pinus renamed to '''Crisp'''. Newbee's [[LPL/2017_Season/Summer_Season|Summer Season]] in the LPL was similar to Spring: They placed 3rd in their group with 9 wins and 7 losses. In the [[LPL/2017_Season/Summer_Playoffs|playoffs]], they swept [[Snake Esports]] 3-0 in the first round but then got swept themselves by [[Team WE]] in the quarterfinals. At the end of the season, Newbee disbanded and Crisp joined [[FunPlus Phoenix]].

== Trivia ==
* His former ID '''Lqs''' stood for his real name (Liu Qing-Song). On [[Tan Chi Sa Gaming]], all of the players used their initials as their IDs.
{{PlayerStatsTrivia}}
* Known for his mastery in hook champions, like {{ci|Thresh}} and {{ci|Nautilus}}.
* He is very close friends with [[Clearlove]]. The two duo'ed with each other a lot on stream and often hang out.<!--
* His Tieba ID is 撕破伤口丶, which means "Tearing wounds dot".-->
* He is huge fan of ''[[wikipedia:en:Cheng_Xiao|Cheng Xiao]]'', Chinese actress, dancer and singer.
